ns2:course.label: Federal Taxation
ns2:course.description: Introduction to historical and conceptual as well as applied material in the accounting area of federal taxation; emphasizes the provisions of the tax law relevant to accounting measurement methods. Credit is not given for both ACCY 505 and ACCY 312. Prerequisite: ACCY 501; enrollment in graduate degree program or consent of department.
